controls.justification: Control 6.7 (Remote working) is recommended to address vulnerabilities such as WinRM Remote Command Execution Exposure across affected File Server assets and support the selected mitigation treatment.

- Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all remote access sessions to SRV-03.  
- Conduct a vulnerability scan on SRV-03 to identify and remediate additional unpatched vulnerabilities.  
- Deploy a secure remote access solution (e.g., encrypted VPN) for remote users connecting to SRV-03.  
- Enforce regular updates and patch management for File Server assets through an automated vulnerability management process (Control 8.8).  
- Review and update secure coding practices for applications interacting with SRV-03 to prevent similar exposure vulnerabilities (Control 8.28).  
- Segment SRV-03 into a dedicated network zone with strict firewall rules to limit lateral movement risks (Control 8.20).  
- Train remote workers on secure access protocols and incident reporting for suspicious activities related to remote management.

- Monitor and log all network service activity on affected hosts for real-time threat detection and forensic analysis.  
- Review and update access control lists (ACLs) for network services to ensure only authorized users and systems can interact with them.  
- Perform quarterly audits of network service configurations to ensure alignment with ISO 27002:2022 control 8.21 requirements.
